summary.bn: দুই তারে চলা ছোট ডিসপ্লে: লেখা আর ছবি দেখায়।
summary.en: A small display on two wires, for text and pictures.

simplified: It works with the ESP32 board and the lab's own model of that board only. Programs for the UNO-compatible board and for the chip emulator cannot use it yet.
The program and the display exchange whole messages; the bits on the SDA and SCL wires are not produced, so the oscilloscope and logic analyser show both lines resting HIGH.
It is drawn with its pins at the bottom and the picture upright. On the real module the pins are along the top edge.
Its legs are in the order GND, VCC, SCL, SDA. Some modules have VCC and GND the other way round: read the labels on yours.
Scrolling by the display itself is left out, and a picture changes at once: there is no flicker or slow update.
The current it draws is fixed; a real display draws more the more pixels are lit.
The pull-up resistors on its bus lines are an estimate.
